findings.message: No JSON-LD block in the post.
Hours for sun do not match the ficha.
Internal link points to a page that is not in the ficha page list.
Link could not be confirmed (403); check by hand.

findings.quote: A child's first dental visit should happen at age three.
findings.why: ADA and AAPD recommend the first visit by the first birthday or within six months of the first tooth, not at age three, so this delays care and misleads parents.
findings.fix: Replace with: a child's first dental visit should happen by their first birthday or within six months of the first tooth appearing.

findings.quote: We are open Sundays from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.
findings.why: The ficha lists no Sunday hours, so the clinic is closed Sundays, and this also contradicts the correct hours later in the post.
findings.fix: Delete the sentence; the correct Monday-Friday hours are already given in the final section.

findings.quote: We are open Sundays from 9:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.
findings.why: The first-person plural sentence is dropped in awkwardly mid-paragraph and reads like pasted boilerplate, unlike the rest of the post.
findings.fix: Remove it, or move accurate hours into the contact section only.

findings.why: /services/clear-aligners is not in the ficha's list of existing pages, so the internal link would be broken.
findings.fix: Link to /services, which exists, or remove the link.

findings.quote: For older siblings, see our [clear aligner page]
findings.why: The aligner mention is an abrupt, off-topic jump in a post about a child's first visit.
findings.fix: Remove it or tie it to the family dentistry services more naturally.

findings.quote: Avoid putting a baby to bed with a bottle containing anything other than water.
findings.why: This is consistent with mainstream guidance (ADA, AAPD), and the post lists AAPD and CDC sources at the end, though it does not cite them inline.
findings.fix: Optionally add an inline citation to the AAPD or CDC source.

findings.quote: brush twice a day with a soft, small-bristled toothbrush. Use an age-appropriate amount of fluoride toothpaste based on your dentist’s or doctor’s advice.
findings.why: Guidance is vague; ADA specifies a smear of fluoride toothpaste (rice-grain size) for children under 3 and a pea-sized amount for ages 3 to 6.
findings.fix: State the rice-grain and pea-size amounts explicitly, citing the ADA.

findings.quote: For a child under two, ask a health professional about fluoride toothpaste;
findings.why: ADA recommends a smear of fluoride toothpaste from the first tooth, so deferring to a professional is cautious but less clear than it could be.
findings.fix: Add the ADA's smear-sized-amount guidance for children under 3.

findings.quote: For directions or scheduling information, visit the clinic’s contact page or call the main number, (512) 555-0142.
findings.why: The contact page is mentioned without a link, and the post gives no address or emergency-line instruction even though it mentions toothache and injury.
findings.fix: Link to /contact and mention the after-hours on-call prompt for injuries.

findings.quote: If a child has a toothache, injury, or another concern, mention it when arranging the appointment so the team knows what to discuss.
findings.why: The ficha provides an after-hours emergency line and emergency care, but the post does not tell parents to call promptly for an injury.
findings.fix: Add that for a dental injury or severe pain, parents should call the main number right away and follow the on-call prompt after hours.
